title: Site audience
description: Who reads the sites: people, assistants on a person's behalf, link previews, crawlers. Classes come from the bot name in the access logs; no IP address is logged and nothing identifies a visitor. Internal.

panels.title: People
panels.description: Browsers: HTML pages served with status 200 to a User-Agent that names no bot.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="human", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" [$__range]))

panels.title: LLM for a user
panels.description: An assistant opening a page because someone asked it something: ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User and the like. Not training or index crawls.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="bot", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | bot=~"ChatGPT-User|Claude-User|Perplexity-User|meta-externalfetcher|MistralAI-User|DuckAssistBot" | path!="/robots.txt" [$__range]))

panels.title: Link previews
panels.description: A platform fetching a link card because someone pasted a link: LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, Reddit, Mastodon. Pages and preview images; robots.txt left out.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="bot", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page|asset" | bot=~"facebookexternalhit|LinkedInBot|Twitterbot|Slackbot|Discordbot|TelegramBot|WhatsApp|redditbot|Mastodon" | path!="/robots.txt" [$__range]))

panels.title: AI crawlers
panels.description: Training and AI index crawlers: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Amazonbot, meta-externalagent and the like.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="bot", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | bot=~"GPTBot|OAI-SearchBot|ClaudeBot|Claude-SearchBot|anthropic-ai|PerplexityBot|Google-Extended|Applebot-Extended|Bytespider|CCBot|Amazonbot|meta-externalagent|cohere-ai|YouBot|Diffbot" | path!="/robots.txt" [$__range]))

panels.title: /map/ by people
panels.description: The window. Human page views of /map/ only: the most reliable sign that a person looked.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="human", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | path="/map/" [$__range]))

panels.title: Visitor classes per hour
panels.description: Rows are visitor classes, columns are hours, colour is requests on an exponential scale (crawlers outnumber people by far). A LinkedIn post shows as link previews, then humans, sometimes LLM fetches, in the hours after. 1 Human: Browsers: HTML pages served with status 200 to a User-Agent that names no bot. 2 LLM for a user: An assistant opening a page because someone asked it something: ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User and the like. Not training or index crawls. 3 Link preview: A platform fetching a link card because someone pasted a link: LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, Reddit, Mastodon. Pages and preview images; robots.txt left out. 4 AI crawler: Training and AI index crawlers: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Amazonbot, meta-externalagent and the like. 5 Search crawler: Search engine crawlers: Googlebot, bingbot, Applebot, YandexBot and the like. 6 Other bot: Everything else that announces itself as a bot or script: SEO tools, monitors, generic crawlers.

panels.title: Humans and LLMs on the site, per hour (heuristic: same hours)
panels.description: Human page views against assistant fetches and link previews. When they cluster in the same hours on the same pages (see the matrix), a person and their LLM are likely reading together. A heuristic: no visitor is identified.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="human", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="bot", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | bot=~"ChatGPT-User|Claude-User|Perplexity-User|meta-externalfetcher|MistralAI-User|DuckAssistBot" | path!="/robots.txt" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Sections by visitor class
panels.description: Top sections (first two path segments) per class over the selected range, joined: a section with numbers in both Human and LLM for a user is read by people and by assistants on someone's behalf. Empty cell = not in that class's top 30.

targets.expr: topk(30, sum by (section) (count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="human", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | label_format section=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^(/[^/]+/[^/]+/).*$" .path "${1}" }}` [$__range])))

topk(30, sum by (section) (count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="bot", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | bot=~"ChatGPT-User|Claude-User|Perplexity-User|meta-externalfetcher|MistralAI-User|DuckAssistBot" | path!="/robots.txt" | label_format section=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^(/[^/]+/[^/]+/).*$" .path "${1}" }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: How people reached /map/
panels.description: direct = no referrer (typed, a bookmark, an app link, the owner); internal = a link on the site.

targets.expr: sum by (referrer) (count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="human", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | path="/map/" [$__range]))

panels.title: Where /map/ viewers are
panels.description: ISO 3166 code CloudFront derives; no IP address is stored.

targets.expr: sum by (country) (count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="human", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | path="/map/" [$__range]))

panels.title: /map/ per hour: people, assistants, previews
panels.description: The window over time. Link previews of /map/ or its image mean someone pasted the link.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="human", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | path="/map/" [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({job="site-traffic", agent="bot", site=~"$site"} | json | kind=~"page" | bot=~"ChatGPT-User|Claude-User|Perplexity-User|meta-externalfetcher|MistralAI-User|DuckAssistBot" | path!="/robots.txt" | path="/map/" [$__interval]))
